column1: # Deskripsi skill musuh/HOC/summon - putaran 8, bagian b
# Nama tetap Inggris: Smoke Zone, Cocoon, Fortress Device, Temblor Titan,
# Violent Shot, Twin-Linked Machine Gun - Far North Harbor, Jiangyu.
=The damage multiplier increases depending on the number of stacks of <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> on the target.
column2: Damage multiplier meningkat sesuai jumlah stack <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> pada target.

column1: =Deals AoE Physical damage to all enemy targets in a <color=#f26c1c>5×4 tile area facing forward</color> and applies <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Memberikan AoE Physical damage pada semua target musuh dalam <color=#f26c1c>area 5×4 tile menghadap ke depan</color> dan memberikan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column1: =If this unit has <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, charges <color=#f26c1c>4 tiles</color> forward, dealing fixed damage to any targets hit.
column2: Jika unit ini memiliki <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, menerjang <color=#f26c1c>4 tile</color> ke depan, memberikan fixed damage pada target mana pun yang terkena.

column1: =When the charge stops, deals AoE Physical damage and stability damage to all enemy targets in a <color=#f26c1c>5×4 tile area facing forward</color> as well as applying <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Saat terjangan berhenti, memberikan AoE Physical damage dan Stability damage pada semua target musuh dalam <color=#f26c1c>area 5×4 tile menghadap ke depan</color> serta memberikan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column1: =Selects 1 allied unit <color=#f26c1c>within 6 tiles</color> and creates a <color=#f26c1c>3 tile radius</color> Smoke Zone around it for 1 round.
column2: Memilih 1 unit sekutu <color=#f26c1c>dalam 6 tile</color> dan menciptakan Smoke Zone <color=#f26c1c>berradius 3 tile</color> di sekitarnya selama 1 ronde.

column1: =Allied units within the Smoke Zone gain <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.
column2: Unit sekutu di dalam Smoke Zone mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column1: =At the end of the round, ally units within the area gain <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.
column2: Pada akhir ronde, unit sekutu di dalam area mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.

column1: =Selects 1 allied unit and create a Smoke Zone on its position.
column2: Memilih 1 unit sekutu dan menciptakan Smoke Zone di posisinya.

column1: =At the end of the round, allied units within the area gain <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.
column2: Pada akhir ronde, unit sekutu di dalam area mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.

column1: =Cleanses <color=#f26c1c>3 buffs</color> from the user before attacking.
column2: Membersihkan <color=#f26c1c>3 buff</color> dari pengguna sebelum menyerang.

column1: =If the enemy target has <color=#f26c1c>5 or fewer</color> debuffs, attack is reduced by <color=#f26c1c>90%</color>.
column2: Jika target musuh memiliki <color=#f26c1c>5 debuff atau kurang</color>, Attack berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>90%</color>.

column1: =After the attack is resolved, cleanse <color=#f26c1c>1 debuff</color> from the enemy.
column2: Setelah serangan berlaku, membersihkan <color=#f26c1c>1 debuff</color> dari musuh.

column1: =Generates <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> tiles around this unit and deals damage to all enemy units on the battlefield who are standing on <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.
column2: Menghasilkan tile <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> di sekitar unit ini dan memberikan damage pada semua unit musuh di medan pertempuran yang berdiri di <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.

column1: =Gains <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> based on the number of enemy units hit.
column2: Mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> berdasarkan jumlah unit musuh yang terkena.

column1: =If all <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> have the <color=#3487e0>{3}</color> status, this unit damages itself.
column2: Jika semua <color=#3487e0>{2}</color> berstatus <color=#3487e0>{3}</color>, unit ini melukai dirinya sendiri.

column1: =At the start of the round, cleanse all control effects on this unit.
column2: Pada awal ronde, membersihkan semua efek kendali pada unit ini.

column1: =When Cocoon's HP is greater than a certain value, she is immune to damage.
column2: Saat HP Cocoon lebih dari nilai tertentu, ia kebal terhadap damage.

column1: =When her HP is lower than a certain value, she is immune to control effects.
column2: Saat HP-nya lebih rendah dari nilai tertentu, ia kebal terhadap efek kendali.

column1: =At the start of each turn, if you are in an exposed state, gain <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, and <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>, lasting for 1 turn.
column2: Pada awal tiap giliran, jika Anda dalam kondisi terekspos, mendapatkan <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>, dan <color=#3487e0>{2}</color>, bertahan selama 1 giliran.

column1: =When inflicted with Stability Break, summon 1 random attribute <color=#3487e0>[Fortress Device]</color> in each of the 4 directions around you.
column2: Saat terkena Stability Break, memanggil 1 <color=#3487e0>[Fortress Device]</color> beratribut acak di tiap 4 arah di sekitar Anda.

column1: =When a <color=#3487e0>[Fortress Device]</color> dies, the Temblor Titan receives fixed damage equal to its health, and gains the positional and weapon weaknesses of that fortress device.
column2: Saat <color=#3487e0>[Fortress Device]</color> mati, Temblor Titan menerima fixed damage sebesar HP perangkat itu, dan mewarisi kelemahan posisi serta kelemahan senjata milik perangkat tersebut.

column1: =When healed, if this unit's HP is greater than <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>, reduces healing received by <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.
column2: Saat disembuhkan, jika HP unit ini lebih dari <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>, healing yang diterima berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.

column1: =When dealing damage, if this unit does not have a <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>-type effect, damage dealt is reduced by <color=#f26c1c>25%</color>.
column2: Saat memberikan damage, jika unit ini tidak memiliki efek bertipe <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, damage yang diberikan berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>25%</color>.

column1: =If the enemy target does not have Freeze debuffs, damage dealt is reduced by <color=#f26c1c>25%</color>.
column2: Jika target musuh tidak memiliki debuff Freeze, damage yang diberikan berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>25%</color>.

column1: =When receiving healing, if this unit's HP is greater than <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>, reduces healing received.
column2: Saat menerima healing, jika HP unit ini lebih dari <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>, healing yang diterima berkurang.

column1: =When dealing damage, if this unit does not have <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>-type effects, damage dealt is reduced by <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.
column2: Saat memberikan damage, jika unit ini tidak memiliki efek bertipe <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>, damage yang diberikan berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.

column2: Jika target musuh memiliki debuff bertipe Freeze, damage yang diberikan berkurang sebesar <color=#f26c1c>50%</color>.

column1: =Generates <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> around all enemy targets that do not possess <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> within a <color=#f26c1c>3×3 area</color> around them.
column2: Menghasilkan <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> di sekitar semua target musuh yang tidak memiliki <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> dalam <color=#f26c1c>area 3×3</color> di sekitar mereka.

column1: =This effect is permanent.
column2: Efek ini permanen.

column1: =If <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> already exists within the area, deals fixed damage equal to <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> of each enemy unit's max HP to all enemy units on <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.
column2: Jika <color=#3487e0>{1}</color> sudah ada di dalam area, memberikan fixed damage sebesar <color=#f26c1c>100%</color> dari Max HP tiap unit musuh pada semua unit musuh yang berada di <color=#3487e0>{1}</color>.

column1: =Damage taken is reduced by 30%.
column2: Damage yang diterima berkurang sebesar 30%.

column1: =After taking <color=#2caadb>Hydro damage</color>, gains <color=#3487e0>{0}</color> for <color=#f26c1c>2 turns</color>.

column1: =Debuff can be dispelled.

column1: =After taking <color=#2caadb>Hydro damage</color>, gains <color=#3487e0>{0}</color>.

column1: =After moving, attack is increased by <color=#f26c1c>30%</color> and <color=#d4ae08>Electric damage</color> dealt is increased by <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> until the end of the turn.
column2: Setelah bergerak, Attack meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>30%</color> dan <color=#d4ae08>Electric damage</color> yang diberikan meningkat sebesar <color=#f26c1c>50%</color> sampai akhir giliran.
